notes.title: "Mojika - Truth Rears Its Ugly Head" is now available!
notes.content:
[h1] [b]I Know Your Ugliness[/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2697560

The international version of "Mojika - Truth Rears Its Ugly Head" developed by NitroOrigin and published by JAST has now been launched on STEAM! The achievement system is supported (there is a conflict with the patch). There is a 10% discount for the initial release (for one week)!

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2697560/extras/mojika_image_05.gif?t=1743433723[/img]

This work has its script written by Shimokura Vio (whose representative works include "Your Love Story with Her and Her", "Tokyo Necro", and "STEINS; GATE") and its original art created by Hamashima Shigeo (whose representative works include "euphoria" and "Yua Club").

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2697560/extras/mojika_image_03.gif?t=1743433723[/img]

[h3]Story Overview[/h3]
Suteru is an outcast burdened by his ugly appearance who possesses a rare and unsettling gift called “Wordsight” in which thoughts materialize as words. His unique ability allows him to uncover the disturbing secrets of those who torment him and help him seek revenge.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2697560/extras/mojika_image_04.gif?t=1743433723[/img]

[h3]Known Possible Problems and Solutions:[/h3]
1. Crashing when fast-forwarding
- If you fast-forward too much, it may get stuck when using “Wordsight”. Just restart the game.

2. Infinite loop when fast-forwarding the plot in the broadcasting room
- Please cancel the fast-forward and click to proceed with the plot.

3. Black screen of the "Word Curse" during the plot in Hanatsubaki Shin'in
- Please cancel the fast-forward and click to proceed with the plot.

4. c++ error message appears before the True Ending
- Please restart the game and load the save file.

5. No response after starting the game
- There may be such a situation when starting the launcher for the first time. Please wait patiently for the launcher to appear.

If you have any other questions, it is recommended to consult through the official social media or the customer service email to get a quicker response.
Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Update: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
1.01 Change Log:
[list]
[*]Added a "Change Save Folder" function to the launcher.
[*]Users who had crashing issues due their save folder path containing unsupported characters can now get around it by changing their save folder to a path that contains only English characters.
[*]Added subtitles to Sonico's congratulatory message on the Ending List menu, which appears after unlocking all endings.
[*]Fixed bug that was preventing unlocking of True Sonicomi Master achievement. The achievement should now unlock upon acquiring the last costume part. Users who have already acquired all costume parts will unlock the achievement upon entering the title menu.
[/list]
